boards.title: Your First Weekend at Quinnipiac University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered first-weekend sequence using ten distinct Quinnipiac and nearby outdoor destinations.

cards.title: Begin on the Mount Carmel Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Meet your group among the Quad’s Adirondack chairs, then use the open lawn as a simple landmark for orienting yourselves on campus.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor meeting point framed by campus buildings and views toward Sleeping Giant.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies the Quad as the heart of the Mount Carmel Campus, with casual seating and spaces for community gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Located on Quinnipiac’s Mount Carmel Campus; use the university’s interactive campus map for navigation.

cards.title: Settle into Arnold Bernhard Library
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Take a quiet reset here: choose a study seat, map out the week ahead, or ask a librarian how to start using campus resources.
cards.short_summary: A 48,000-square-foot library for study, collaboration, research, computers and librarian help.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says Arnold Bernhard Library supports study, group projects and research, with computers and librarian assistance.
cards.access_notes: University library access and services may vary by visitor status; confirm current access before relying on a particular service.

cards.title: Find your bearings at Carl Hansen
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Walk through the student center and locate Campus Life, then make a note of where to return when you want to connect with an activity.
cards.short_summary: A Mount Carmel multipurpose facility and one location for the Department of Campus Life.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes Carl Hansen Student Center as a Mount Carmel multipurpose facility; its Department of Campus Life has an office there.
cards.source_title: Department of Campus Life | Quinnipiac University Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Campus Life is listed in suite 202 of Carl Hansen Student Center, temporarily in the DOME suite 202; verify current location on arrival.

cards.title: Put the Engagement Fair on your calendar
cards.subtitle: Early fall semester • Quinnipiac University
cards.notes: When the fair is scheduled, walk the tables with one goal: collect details from a few groups that genuinely match your interests.
cards.short_summary: An annual early-semester opportunity to learn about and sign up for student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says its annual Engagement Fair occurs during the first week of classes and encourages undergraduates to explore 190+ student-run organizations.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: This is an annual activity rather than a drop-in destination; consult Quinnipiac’s events calendar for the current date and location.

cards.title: Try the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Choose a low-pressure first visit: tour the fitness areas, ask about group classes, or check whether an open recreation session fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A 2023 wellness facility with fitness spaces, classes, a climbing wall and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says its Recreation and Wellness Center offers fitness studios, equipment and classes, a rock-climbing wall, health services and counseling space.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Fitness-center hours and program availability are published separately by Quinnipiac; check current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a daytime walk at Sleeping Giant
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Mount Carmel Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Plan a daylight outing, bring water, and select a route appropriate for your group before heading onto the park’s trails.
cards.short_summary: A Connecticut state park at the foot of Quinnipiac’s Mount Carmel Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac states that its Mount Carmel Campus is located at the foot of Sleeping Giant State Park.
cards.access_notes: Use Connecticut State Parks information to confirm trail conditions, parking and any advisories before a visit.

cards.title: Ride over to Rocky Top Student Center
cards.subtitle: York Hill Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Use the student center as a York Hill stop: look around the meeting spaces and pause by the two-story stone fireplace before continuing.
cards.short_summary: York Hill’s social hub, with dining, meeting spaces, a fitness center and a two-story stone fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes Rocky Top Student Center as the social heart of York Hill, with dining, meeting spaces, a fitness center and a two-story stone fireplace.
cards.access_notes: York Hill Campus is at 305 Sherman Avenue in Hamden; verify current campus transportation and building access through Quinnipiac.

cards.title: Meet at the Bronze Bobcat Statue
cards.subtitle: Outside M&T Bank Arena • York Hill Campus
cards.notes: Make this statue a clear rendezvous point before an arena visit, then take a group photo without blocking the entrance or pedestrian flow.
cards.short_summary: A named bronze bobcat sculpture on the approach to Quinnipiac’s arena.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says spectators pass the bronze bobcat statue on their way to M&T Bank Arena.
cards.access_notes: The statue is on the York Hill Campus arena approach; event operations may affect access nearby.

cards.title: Check the M&T Bank Arena schedule
cards.subtitle: York Hill Campus • Hamden
cards.notes: Choose an all-ages Bobcat athletic event that fits your weekend, and confirm the event’s entry rules and ticket details before traveling over.
cards.short_summary: The York Hill home venue for Quinnipiac ice hockey, basketball, and acrobatics and tumbling teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies M&T Bank Arena as home to its ice hockey, basketball, and acrobatics and tumbling teams.
cards.access_notes: Admission, age policies and availability depend on the specific event; verify the current arena schedule and entry information before attending.

cards.title: Finish with a Welcome Weekend event
cards.subtitle: Before fall-semester classes • Quinnipiac University
cards.notes: Use the published Welcome Weekend schedule to pick one community event, arrive with your residence group, and keep plans flexible around move-in.
cards.short_summary: A pre-semester welcome program with a ceremony, barbecue and other activities for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says Welcome Weekend takes place the week before fall classes and includes a welcome ceremony, welcome BBQ and activities.
cards.source_title: Events, Activities and Traditions | Quinnipiac University
cards.access_notes: Welcome Weekend is scheduled before fall-semester classes; confirm the current program, locations and participation details with Quinnipiac.
